BUILDPLAN.md T-10 (M2).

Discord OAuth: scopes, member lookup, role-**ID** check at room creation, the Administrator test, refresh-token rotation persisted, bounded retries, denial wording; **deletes the M1 stand-in** (the `dev-host-token` feature) and adds the test that a build without it accepts no stand-in token (`SPEC.md` §8.2)

Criteria: AC-64–70, G-9
Harness hooks: see EVALUATION.md rows for those IDs; `just test` is the inner loop (≤ 60 s).
Depends on (BUILDPLAN): T-04a–b
BUILDPLAN notes: Human track: app id, secret, guild id, role id. The live check against the client's account is this ticket's exit criterion and gates HC-1

Orchestrator notes: Human track H-3. The live check against the client's account is the exit criterion and gates HC-1, never HC-0.

HELD: needs H-3 the Discord app: id, secret, guild id, role id. Do not dispatch until the client releases it.

Workflow mode: inline-full. Terminal pre-merge status: review. PR base: origin/main.
Standing clauses: criteria outrank SPEC on behaviour, state, payloads and copy; SPEC outranks the prototype, which wins on visual detail only. Never write down what a program prints. Answer position is a uniform draw from the date, never balanced. Miri proves absence of UB on executed paths only. Colour is never the only signal. Code never causes horizontal page scroll. Never `git add -A`. Signing goes through 1Password: retry once, then escalate.

Plan: filled in by the delegator's plan phase.

AppState gains create_room_checked/run_again_checked (async, used by routes); the existing sync create_room/run_again keep their signatures and delegate (poll once; a check that would wait is Unavailable) so no other ticket's tests change; run_again's old body moved verbatim into private run_again_for. Disjoint from PQ-17's schedule(). tests/common TestAuth's one impl signature changes accordingly.

ORCHESTRATOR ruling on QUESTION PQ-13 (23:5x): (1) CLEARED — room/tests/smoke_config.rs, additively: the config() helper supplies the four DISCORD_* names in the same one-line shape PQ-17 used for its admin token; PQ-17 touches the same helper this wave, so keep yours a delimited line and expect a union at merge. (2) The justfile stays PQ-17's this wave. You are cleared for exactly one line under test-full (the ignored lifecycle AC-69 test), applied only AFTER PQ-17's PR has merged and you have merged origin/main (the merge order already puts PQ-17 first); until then carry the line in your plan and DONE, not in the file. (3) FYI async authorize_create: accepted as a forced seam change (Discord is I/O). Keep the sync create_room/run_again signatures delegating as you describe so no sibling's tests move; prefer routes on the async path only; record it as a deviation with the poll-once semantics spelled out for the validator. Signing is still down from every seat at 23:57 — stage and flag when you reach a commit, never bypass.

QUESTION PQ-13 (implementing): the canary's route-table guard (room/tests/canary_scan/mod.rs, PQ-17's) fails on my two new routes: 'routes.rs serves GET /auth/discord and the canary neither scans it nor lists it'. They need entries in canary_scan's UNSCANNED (or DRIVEN). Proposed, two lines in UNSCANNED: ("GET", "/auth/discord", "T-10 sign-in start: a redirect to Discord; served only with the Discord backend, which the canary's TestAuth state has not; tests/auth.rs secrecy_* scans it with Discord canaries") and the same for ("GET", "/auth/discord/callback", …). May I add them (delimited T-10 lines), or will PQ-17/you place them at merge? Until then just test-room is red on that one test only.

ORCHESTRATOR ruling (posted 02:5x, decided 00:2x — the Orchestrator's tool gate was down): CLEARED — add GET /auth/discord and GET /auth/discord/callback to canary_scan's UNSCANNED as two delimited T-10 lines with the reasons you wrote (tests/auth.rs secrecy_* scans them with Discord canaries). Three delimited blocks in that file this wave (PQ-17 admin, PQ-15 /last, yours); union at merge; whoever merges later re-runs just canary.

PQ-13: client approved the three host strings verbatim in the tab: host_action_sign_in 'Sign in with Discord'; host_denied_wrong_server 'That Discord account isn't in the Rust NYC server.'; host_denied_wrong_role 'That Discord account doesn't have the organizer role.' (F-33: §11 rows still to be added upstream.)

LIVE CHECK PQ-13 (H-3, exit criterion; run by the client in their own terminal on PR head 1dbec1d, 2026-09-29): PASS on the role check. Client's account signed in via real Discord OAuth against the real guild; Create a room returned 409 'No question is scheduled with that id.' The create path awaits authorize_create before the question lookup (rooms.rs create_room_checked), so that reply means Discord's member lookup found DISCORD_ROLE_ID in the client's roles; creation stopped only because nothing is scheduled (the scheduling channel is PQ-17's, not on this branch). Not run: a second account without the role (optional per the brief). Values never entered this tab or a file.

DONE PQ-13 PR https://github.com/mrojas54/rust-nyc-pop-quiz/pull/32 HEAD 1dbec1d1853cca60293a67d75095e5ab2b91a2d5 BASE f8f9cafa57e792d5fa33c86ef0899ab98faad703 test-warm 17.7s (room, cargo test --no-fail-fast) + 0.2s (web, 197/197) deviations: (1) HostAuth::authorize_create is async (Discord is I/O): routes use AppState::create_room_checked/run_again_checked; the sync create_room/run_again keep their signatures and poll the check once (futures now_or_never) — a check that would have to wait is RoomError::Unavailable — so they serve only I/O-free backends (tests' TestAuth); run_again's old body moved verbatim to run_again_for. (2) RoomError gains WrongServer/WrongRole/Unavailable; AppState gains additive discord field + with_discord(); organizer store lives inside the Discord backend AppState owns (§9). (3) Cleared edits outside the list: tests/smoke_config.rs (one line: four DISCORD_* vars), tests/canary_scan/mod.rs (two UNSCANNED T-10 lines). (4) tests/common TestAuth impl signature changed (forced by the seam). (5) No new crate: rustls/tokio-rustls/webpki-roots de-optionalized (already locked; Cargo.lock unchanged). (6) .env.example: four names plus one comment line appended by mistake (removal was denied). (7) smoke now reads POPQUIZ_ORGANIZER_SESSION (a signed-in organizer's 12 h session), not a shared secret — T-21's automated deployed smoke will need a fresh human sign-in or another way to create its room. (8) Copy: three keys in a new COPY_ROWS row 'Host, sign-in and denials (T-10, F-33)'; client-approved wording; the denials avoid the Forbidden word 'wrong'. notes: live H-3 check PASS on the role check (see LIVE CHECK comment; second no-role account not run). Pending after PQ-17 merges: git merge origin/main (merge, not rebase), add the one cleared justfile test-full line 'cd room && cargo test --offline --locked --test lifecycle -- --ignored test_full_', re-run just test and just canary. The deployed room keeps running the stand-in image until the client deploys from main; at that deploy the current host URL stops working and Discord sign-in replaces it (set the four fly secrets and register https://rustnyc-popquiz.fly.dev/auth/discord/callback first). Stale for upstream: SPEC §4.6/§8.2 prose, fly.toml:22 and .env.example still name the stand-in var; .dockerignore still admits q3.json.

ORCHESTRATOR NOTE (00:5x): PQ-17 merged — origin/main is now 73404d7 (PR #33, admin channel). Two things for you: (1) merge origin/main into ai-c11-cc/discord-auth (a merge commit, no rebase), resolve the canary_scan/mod.rs union (PQ-17 T-25 block + yours), re-run just canary and just test-room, push (the ask rule prompts), and confirm both CI jobs green on the new head. (2) You are now cleared for your one justfile line under test-full (the ignored AC-69 lifecycle test) — apply it in the same push. Then keep waiting on the client live check; post DONE with the new HEAD when it passes. Merge order unchanged: you are next after your live check.

DONE PQ-13 (post-merge) PR https://github.com/mrojas54/rust-nyc-pop-quiz/pull/32 HEAD f1a71bfe51e5a5b2a2ba1b6bf49c9dd5aa9286c1 BASE 73404d7373aa490e8b4b823e5e02d65b64750daf test-warm 15.4s (just test-room) + 0.2s (web 197/197); just canary 12/12; test-full AC-69 line added and passing; CI on f1a71bfe51e5a5b2a2ba1b6bf49c9dd5aa9286c1: 'just test' SUCCESS, 'just test-full' SUCCESS; PR MERGEABLE. Merge: plain merge commit f1a71bf of origin/main 73404d7 (no rebase); unions in config.rs (admin token checked before the Discord block), lib.rs, main.rs, rooms.rs (schedule() + the checked doors), routes.rs (T-10 + T-25 blocks), smoke_config.rs, .env.example, room/README.md; canary_scan/mod.rs auto-merged (PQ-17 block + mine); tests/standin.rs kept deleted. deviations added by the merge: (9) tests/admin.rs stand_in() and tests/canary.rs::the_binary_logs_no_admin_token now supply the four DISCORD_* vars (required by every build) — minimal edits to PQ-17's tests, forced by the union. (10) rooms.rs AppState doc line from PQ-17 named the stand-in (would trip the AC-64 scan): reworded. (11) .env.example: resolving the conflict dropped my stray comment line, so deviation (6) is gone — it now carries POPQUIZ_ADMIN_TOKEN= and the four DISCORD_* names only. Live H-3 check: PASS on the role check, run by the client on 1dbec1d (see LIVE CHECK comment); the merge changed no Discord code. All earlier deviations (1)-(5),(7),(8) and notes stand.

MERGE-REVIEW (fresh, exact head f1a71bfe51e5a5b2a2ba1b6bf49c9dd5aa9286c1 on 73404d7, Sonnet, static): VERDICT PASS-WITH-NITS. Critical: none. Major: none. Minor: (1) stand-in still named outside the AC-64 scan's file set (scan covers room/src, CI, Cargo.toml, Dockerfile): .env.example:39-40 HOST_DEV_TOKEN, fly.toml:22, justfile:175/211-221 smoke comments (smoke.rs now reads POPQUIZ_ORGANIZER_SESSION), README.md:104 'stand-in credential today', room/tests/canary_full.rs:15-31 message — fix or widen the scan. (2) Discord tokens are memory-only (discord.rs:47-51, 213); rotation is 'written before the old token drops' (563-570); a restart signs every organizer out — matches SPEC §9 in-memory state but AC-66's 'persisted' wording is stronger than the implementation (upstream note). (3) GET /auth/discord is unauthenticated and evicts the oldest pending sign-in past 256 (discord.rs:303-305): a flood can evict a real organizer's state; low impact, unbounded by IP. (4) sync create_room/run_again poll once via now_or_never after the check task is spawned (discord.rs:411), so the task can run on orphaned; no production route uses the sync path. Nits: stale HOST_DEV_TOKEN entries/comments in tests/admin.rs:432-435 and tests/smoke_config.rs:24-27; weak disjunction and total_hits equality in the AC-69 lifecycle test; 403 refusal slugs 'wrong_server'/'wrong_role' are machine-only (displayed copy avoids 'wrong'); ac101 no-auth-route test does not drive /auth/discord. Points 1–7 met: stand-in deleted with the four-name scan and the 401 matrix with zero Discord hits; role check is an exact id compare on a roles-only Member, Administrator-without-id denied, check before the question lookup; Secret has no Debug/Display/Clone, client secret only to the fixed token endpoint, one-time state bound to an HttpOnly cookie compared in constant time, session in the fragment with no-store; rotation under the store lock, 3 tries with backoff/Retry-After and an 8 s deadline, 12 h sessions, invalid_grant signs out without touching rooms; the three F-33 strings exact in copy.rs and copy.js and used by routes/host.js; one justfile line at :65; merge unions sound, PQ-17's admin channel unweakened.
